info.title: PageAudit
info.description: Technical SEO auditor that ships the fix. Main client: AI agents. Browsable index at GET /api/.

bearerAuth.description: Guest token (`POST /api/guest`) in `X-Guest-Token: pa_…`, `Authorization: Bearer pa_…` or `?guest_token=pa_…`. A user session (`sess_…`) also works and takes precedence.

id.description: ID of the stored audit; `null` when the database was unavailable.

score.description: Score from 0 to 100, computed from the findings below.

issues.description: Everything found, from most to least severe.

summary.description: What the page declares: title, meta, canonical, OG, headings, links…

counts.description: How many findings of each severity.

headers.description: Every header of the target's response. `Set-Cookie` is removed on purpose: it is a third party's credential.

htmlTruncated.description: `true` when the page passed 2 MB and was read only that far.

jsonLd.description: The raw JSON-LD blocks, as they were on the page.

jsonLdStored.description: How many blocks survived the size cap — compare with `summary.jsonLdBlocks`.

truncated.description: What was cut and why: `jsonld_size`, `jsonld_nodes_over_50`, `result_size`. Empty means nothing cut.

fixes.description: The ready fix of each finding, without a model — paste, fill in or decide. The consolidated one is at `_links.patch`.

quota.description: How much is still free and what it costs past that.

_links.description: This audit, the patch, the share and the API index.

Audit.description: The report of one audit: score, findings and everything observed on the page.

code.description: Stable check code, e.g. `title_missing`. It is what you filter by.

message.description: The finding in one sentence, ready to show a person.

Achado.description: A problem (or a pass) found on the page.

status.description: Final HTTP status of the target.

canonical.description: Canonical URL declared by the page.

faviconSource.description: How the favicon was found: declared or by the default path.

h1s.description: Every `<h1>` on the page, in order.

openGraph.description: The `og:*` tags found, key by key.

jsonLdCount.description: How many JSON-LD nodes the page had.

jsonLdDropped.description: `true` when nodes were dropped for passing the cap.

images.description: Image count and how many have no `alt`.

links.description: Count of internal, external and text-less links.

legacy.description: Old markup still present (e.g. `<font>`, layout tables).

redirects.description: The redirect chain followed to the final URL.

robotsTxt.description: What the origin's `robots.txt` says about this URL.

sitemap.description: Whether the URL appears in the sitemap the origin declares.

ResumoPagina.description: Everything the page declares about itself. It is the most consulted object of the API.

ContagemAchados.description: How many findings of each severity — the summary that fits in a badge.

classe.description: `deterministico` comes whole from the page; `molde` has a `{{…}}` placeholder; `sem_patch` is an instruction.

snippet.description: The ready tag (or with a placeholder). `null` for files and for `sem_patch`.

arquivo.description: `path` and `conteudo` when the fix is a file at the host root.

fonte.description: Where the value came from, or what the page already had (for the template or to check the cut).

nota.description: How to apply, or what to decide.

Correcao.description: The ready fix of one finding. `classe` says whether it is to paste, to fill in or to decide.

free_per_day.description: Free audits per IP per day.

price_usd.description: Price of an audit beyond the allowance, in USD.

CotaAudit.description: How much is still free and what it costs past that.

self.description: This audit, to re-read without re-auditing.

patch.description: `GET /api/audits/:id/patch` — the consolidated patch of this audit.

share.description: Where to publish this audit under a public slug.

LinksAudit.description: Addresses of the audit just created. Without a stored `id`, only `api_index` comes.

url.description: Final audited URL, after following the redirects.

summary.description: What the page declared at the time of the run.

counts.description: How many findings of each severity.

fixes.description: The ready fix of each finding; an audit stored before this existed gets the computation on read.

headers.description: Headers of the target's response, as they were in the run.

truncated.description: What was cut by size when storing.

share_slug.description: Public slug, if this audit was shared.

AuditGravado.description: The same report re-read from the database. It has no `quota` and no `_links` (it is a read, not a run) and gains the date and the share slug.

audit.description: Absolute link of the source audit.

head.description: The deterministic tags, one per line, in <head> order (charset first). Empty when there are none.

arquivos.description: Files to create at the host root.

moldes.description: What only the owner can fill in.

sem_patch.description: What is a decision or infrastructure.

Patch.description: The consolidated patch of an audit, ready for the agent that builds the site to apply.

path.description: Absolute path on the host, e.g. `/robots.txt`.

ArquivoPatch.description: A file to create at the host root.

fonte.description: Suggestion taken from the page itself (H1, og:description…), if any.

nota.description: What to fill in and the limit.

MoldePatch.description: A tag with a marked placeholder: content missing that only the owner knows.

SemPatch.description: Finding without an automatic fix: it is a decision or infrastructure.

ResumoPatch.description: How many fixes of each class.

category.description: Grouping of the tool in the hub.

icon.description: Name of the icon used in the card.

checks.description: Finding codes this tool highlights — they are the `Achado.code`s.

serp.description: How the result looks in the search preview.

_links.description: This tool in JSON and in HTML.

Ferramenta.description: A micro-tool: the landing of one isolated check, with the same engine as the full audit.

shared.description: Whether the audit is published at the end of the call.

path.description: Path of the report's HTML page.

badge.description: Path of the score badge SVG.

_links.description: Report, JSON and badge, as absolute URLs.

Compartilhamento.description: The result of publishing an audit under a non-enumerable slug.

label.description: Text on the left of the badge.

available.description: `false` when the share was revoked — the SVG turns grey `n/a`.

markdown.description: The markdown line ready to paste in the README.

Badge.description: The score badge metadata, to build the README markdown.

active_result.description: The last result of the active tab, so a second call is not needed.

limit.description: How many tabs fit before paying.

gate.description: How much of the IP's free allowance remains.

billing.description: Prices and usage, the same `GET /api/billing` returns.

Workspace.description: The owner's whole workspace, with the active tab's result already rehydrated — one call to draw the screen.

alias.description: Label the person gave the tab.

active.description: Whether it is the focused tab in the workspace.

audit_id.description: Audit of this tab's last run.

Aba.description: A workspace tab: one followed URL, with the last result kept.

ip.description: IP seen by the edge, already masked.

now.description: Time of the query, in epoch.

configured.description: Whether Turnstile is configured in this environment.

free_remaining.description: How many remain today for this IP.

verified_until.description: Until when the verification already done is valid.

needs_verification.description: `true` when the next call will ask for Turnstile (human) or 402 (agent).

sitekey.description: Turnstile sitekey, for the browser to build the challenge.

Gate.description: How much of the daily allowance still exists for this IP, and whether Turnstile is already required.

ok.description: Always `true` — failure comes as a 4xx/5xx status, not as `ok:false`.

Ok.description: Write confirmation with no body of its own to return.

provider.description: Always `x402` — the only billing protocol accepted.

mode.description: Seller mode: `live` charges for real, `dev` lets calls through unpaid.

network.description: USDC network: `base` in production, `base-sepolia` in staging.

chain_id.description: EVM chain ID of the network above, so the wallet signs on the right chain.

homolog.description: Staging seam on: the loop can be closed without spending USDC.

dev_gate.description: How dev mode is unlocked, when it exists.

facilitator.description: URL of the facilitator that verifies and settles the payment.

asset_address.description: USDC contract on the network above.

wallets.description: Links to wallets that speak x402 (metamask, coinbase, base_app).

prices.description: What each paid action costs, in USD.

usage.description: How much of the free allowance has been used.

trial.description: The account's trial, when there is a session.

Billing.description: Everything that decides whether the next call will cost: the x402 configuration, the prices, the usage and the trial.

extra_tab_usd.description: Cost of a tab beyond the allowance.

Precos.description: Prices in force, in dollars. Read them here, not from the documentation.

Uso.description: How much of the free allowance the owner has used.

active.description: Whether it is in force now.

granted.description: `true` when THIS call granted the trial.

Trial.description: The paywall-free period that confirming the e-mail grants. It is the alternative to paying.

today_contacts.description: Contact messages received today. Only with `METRICS_TOKEN`: contact does not leave without a token.

days.description: One record per day of the window, with the counts of each metric.

usage.description: Usage per product resource — here, audits and tabs.

financeiro.description: Aggregate of the day: `hoje_usd`, `hoje_count`, `rede`. Only with `METRICS_TOKEN`: money does not leave without a token; the full series is `payments`.

achados.description: Which findings appear across stored audits: `audits` (total) and `por_codigo[]` with `code`, `n`, `audits` and `fracao_audits`. Aggregate, no URL and no owner; 1 h cache. `null` if the database did not answer.

Metricas.description: 7-day panel. `payments` only shows with the operator token and only on Base mainnet.

post.summary: MCP server over HTTP (Streamable HTTP, JSON-RPC 2.0) — plugs into the client with nothing to install.
post.description:
The tools are the operations of this same catalog; the MCP has no backend of its own. `GET /mcp` returns the server card.
Returns: JSON-RPC 2.0 response (`initialize`, `tools/list` or `tools/call`).
Credentials go in the usual headers (X-Guest-Token, Authorization, X-PAYMENT) and are forwarded to the API.
An exhausted quota comes back as a 402 with accepts[] inside the tool result — pay and repeat.

post.summary: Audits a URL and returns the full report in one call, without a token or a tab.
post.description:
This is the product for agents. Past the IP's daily allowance the response is **402 with `accepts[]`** — pay and repeat the same call. It also carries `sitekey` and `code`, which are the path for a human with a browser; an agent ignores those two. The free alternative: sign up and confirm the e-mail to get the trial.
Returns: { id, score, issues[{severity,code,message}], summary{finalUrl,status,contentType,title,metaDescription,canonical,robots,viewport,charset,lang,favicon,faviconSource,h1s,openGraph,twitter,jsonLdCount,jsonLdBlocks,jsonLdDropped,jsonLdTypes,images,links,words,hreflang,legacy,redirects,robotsTxt,sitemap}, counts{errors,warnings,info}, headers, htmlTruncated, jsonLd, jsonLdStored, truncated, fixes[{code,severity,classe,alvo,snippet,arquivo,fonte,nota}], quota{free_per_day,price_usd}, _links{self?,patch,share?,api_index} }

get.summary: The consolidated patch of an audit: the <head> block ready to paste, the files to create at the root and the templates for what only the owner can fill in — no model, only facts from the page itself.
get.description:
Each finding becomes a fix in one of three classes: `deterministico` (comes whole from what the page declares: final URL, title, description, OG), `molde` (a tag with a marked placeholder, like `{{TITULO}}`, and the suggested source) or `sem_patch` (a decision or infrastructure, with the instruction). Nothing is invented by a model.
Returns: { url, audit, head, arquivos[{code,path,conteudo}], moldes[{code,alvo,snippet,fonte,nota}], sem_patch[{code,nota}], resumo{deterministicos,moldes,sem_patch,total}, como_aplicar, _links }

post.summary: Moves the guest's audits and tabs to the signed-in account.

guest_token.description: Guest `pa_…` whose content moves to the account.

401.description: No credential, or an invalid one. See this endpoint's auth.
No credential, or an invalid one. See this endpoint's auth.

post.summary: Talks to support: a human solves Turnstile, an agent pays $0.10 in x402.
post.description:
Without a captcha in the body the request is treated as an agent: 402 until paid. The first agent message is free; after that the backoff is 60s doubling up to a 1-hour cap, announced in `Retry-After`.
Returns: { ok, path }

name.description: What to call the person writing.

form_ts.description: When the form was opened; it is the anti-robot of the human path.

cf_turnstile_response.description: Turnstile response; present only on the human path.

ok.description: Always `true` when the message was accepted.

path.description: Which path it came through: human with captcha or paid agent.

402.description: Quota exceeded. The response carries `accepts[]` (x402, USDC on Base): pay and repeat the same call with `X-PAYMENT`.

post.summary: Ping from the interface that increments the day's visits. Agents need not call it.
post.description:
Smoke does not count: `X-MM-Smoke`, User-Agent `mm-smoke` or `smoke: true` in the body come in as `counted: false`.
Returns: { ok, counted, reason? }

smoke.description: `true` marks the call as a test and it does not enter the count.

counted.description: Whether the visit entered the day's count.

reason.description: Why it did not count, when `counted` is `false`.

get.summary: Metrics of the last 7 days and the most frequent findings across audits. With the operator token, includes payments.
get.description:
Without credentials it returns visits, usage and accounts. With `METRICS_TOKEN` as Bearer it adds `payments` — and only on Base mainnet, because staging numbers on a finance panel mislead.
Returns: { app, today, today_visits, today_contacts?, days, usage, accounts, financeiro?, payments?, achados }

200.description: { app, today, today_visits, today_contacts?, days, usage, accounts, financeiro?, payments?, achados }

post.summary: Top up prepaid credit: pay once with x402 and get the token that debits on any API of the house.
post.description: Returns: { token, saldo_usd, guarde, usar, saldo_em }

token.description: Bearer token for the balance (`cred_…`). Shown ONCE — it cannot be recovered.

guarde.description: Warning that the token is the bearer of the credit.

usar.description: How to present the token on paid routes.

saldo_em.description: Where to check balance and statement.

402.description: Unpaid — the body carries the x402 `accepts[]`.

get.summary: Credit balance and statement — the latest movements, without returning the token.
get.description: Returns: { saldo_micros, saldo_usd, criado_em, movimentos }

movimentos.description: Recent credits and debits, with product and resource.
